outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic icons and micrograph examples illustrating image cropping/rotation/resizing; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic and micrograph examples of image spacing; not a plot.
Panel c shows schematic and micrograph examples of insets/zoom; not a plot.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast slider schematic and micrograph examples, not a data plot with averages.
Panel e shows schematic color-annotation examples and micrographs, not a data plot.
Panel f shows schematic channel-overlap illustration and grayscale micrographs, not a data plot.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity scale bars (legends), not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
